name: ShadowProxy
description: A browser extension to manage proxy settings and integrate with Burp Suite.

permissions_justification.webRequest: Required for comprehensive traffic logging and monitoring functionality. This permission enables the extension to log HTTP requests (URL, method, resource type, timestamp) for security analysis and debugging purposes, similar to FoxyProxy's logging capabilities. The data is stored locally only and never transmitted externally. This is essential for security professionals who need to track and analyze web traffic when using proxy configurations for penetration testing and security research.
